verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֗יר הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ לְי֣וֹם ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr šîr haš·šab·bāṯ lə·yō·wm ṭō·wḇ lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh ū·lə·zam·mêr lə·šim·ḵā ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: A Psalm A song for the Sabbath day It is good to praise the LORD and to sing praises to Your name O Most High
to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night

verses.original: עֲ‍ֽלֵי־ עָ֭שׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־ נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: with the ten-stringed . . . harp . . . and the melody of the lyre

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֣ה שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי בְּפָעֳלֶ֑ךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh śim·maḥ·ta·nî bə·p̄ā·‘o·le·ḵā ’ă·ran·nên bə·ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: For You, O LORD have made me glad by Your deeds I sing for joy at the works of Your hands

verses.original: מַה־ גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- gā·ḏə·lū ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā Yah·weh mə·’ōḏ ‘ā·mə·qū maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: How great are Your works O LORD how deep are Your thoughts

verses.original: בַּ֭עַר אִֽישׁ־ לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־ יָבִ֥ין אֶת־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ar ’îš- lō yê·ḏā‘ ū·ḵə·sîl lō- yā·ḇîn ’eṯ- zōṯ
verses.literal: A senseless man does not know and a fool does not understand -

verses.original: רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ בִּפְרֹ֤חַ כְּמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב כָּל־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ עַֽד׃ עֲדֵי־ לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: rə·šā·‘îm bip̄·rō·aḥ kə·mōw ‘ê·śeḇ kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen way·yā·ṣî·ṣū ‘aḏ ‘ă·ḏê- lə·hiš·šā·mə·ḏām
verses.literal: that though the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers . . . flourish they will be forever destroyed
But You O LORD are exalted forever . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ כָּל־ פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā Yah·weh kî- hin·nêh ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yō·ḇê·ḏū kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen yiṯ·pā·rə·ḏū
verses.literal: For surely Your enemies O LORD vvv surely Your enemies will perish all evildoers . . . will be scattered

verses.original: וַתָּ֣רֶם קַרְנִ֑י כִּרְאֵ֣ים רַעֲנָֽן׃ בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·rem qar·nî kir·’êm ra·‘ă·nān bə·še·men bal·lō·ṯî
verses.literal: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox with fine oil I have been anointed

verses.original: עֵינִ֗י וַתַּבֵּ֥ט בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י אָזְנָֽי׃ תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה בַּקָּמִ֖ים מְרֵעִ֗ים עָלַ֥י
verses.literal: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק יִפְרָ֑ח כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃ כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq yip̄·rāḥ kat·tā·mār yiś·geh kə·’e·rez bal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon

verses.original: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃ בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ
verses.literal: Planted in the house of the LORD they will flourish in the courts of our God

verses.original: בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.literal: In old age they will still bear fruit healthy and green they will remain

verses.original: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֑ה יָשָׁ֣ר צ֝וּרִ֗י בּֽוֹ׃ וְֽלֹא־ עֹלָתָה
verses.transliteration: lə·hag·gîḏ kî- Yah·weh yā·šār ṣū·rî bōw wə·lō- ʿō·lå̄·ṯå̄h
verses.literal: to proclaim . . . The LORD [is] upright He is my Rock and in Him there is no unrighteousness
